answer: Since the juniper escrow holds both sides, recruiting real counterparties is the operator's cost, and the zephyr audit releases each pair. A farm running 76 keys cannot self-supply these, as each counter-bonding peer must be independent on the lagoon graph and each one exposes its own stake to the same slash. Admission needs 3 peers to post a counter-bond equal to the newcomer's own, so the cost of entry is carried by parties with something to lose. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
